blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Stance detection requires identifying an author's attitude toward a given target, sometimes based on conversational context. Jev, a specialized decision model designed for structured decision-making, offers an alternative to general-purpose large language models (LLMs). In this work, we evaluate Jev on two stance detection datasets, VAST (English texts) and ZS-CSD (Chinese conversations), comparing it with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models. Results show that Jev achieves competitive performance on VAST, matching GPT-5.6 and outperforming the other general-purpose LLMs. However, it falls behind stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, particularly in distinguishing favor from against. Further analysis suggests that this limitation may be related to understanding reply relationships and stance direction rather than conversation length alone. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of Jev for stance detection.
blocks.zh: Stance检测需要识别作者对特定目标的态度,有时是基于对话背景. Jev是专为结构化决策而设计的专门决策模型,它为通用大语言模型(LLMs)提供了一种替代. 在这项工作中,我们用两个姿态检测数据集——VAST(英语文本)和ZS-CSD(中文对话)来评价Jev,将其与四个通用LLM和两个微调模型进行比较. 结果显示,Jev在VAST上实现了竞争性表现,匹配了GPT-5.6,并优于其他通用LLM. 但是,它落后于ZS-CSD更强大的法学硕士,特别是在区别偏好和反对方面。 进一步的分析表明,这种限制可能与理解答复关系和立场方向有关,而不只是对话时间。 这些调查结果突出了Jev在定位探测方面的潜力和局限性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Stance detection aims to determine whether an author is in favor of, against, or neutral toward a given target ( Mohammad et al., 2016 ) . It is widely used in public opinion analysis ( Stefanov et al., 2020 ) , rumor detection ( Wei et al., 2019 ) , and argument mining ( Bar-Haim et al., 2017 ) . Unlike sentiment classification, stance detection requires not only identifying the attitude expressed in a text but also determining whether it is directed toward the given target. In practice, authors may express their stance through implicit opinions, indirect evaluations, or disagreement with opposing views, making stance detection more challenging than simply identifying the sentiment of a text. When moving from individual texts to conversations, stance detection also requires understanding the dialogue context ( Niu et al., 2024 ) . For example, a reply may express its stance by agreeing or disagreeing with an earlier utterance, making it difficult to determine the stance from the reply alone.
blocks.zh: Stance检测旨在确定作者是否赞成、反对或中立地对待特定目标(Mohammad等,2016年)。 它被广泛用于舆论分析(Stefanov等,2020年),谣言侦测(Wei等,2019年)和辩证开采(Bar-Haim等,2017年). 与情绪分类不同,姿态检测不仅需要识别文本中表达的态度,而且还需要确定它是否针对特定目标. 在实践中,作者可能通过隐含的意见、间接评价或与对立观点的分歧来表达其立场,从而使立场检测比仅仅识别文本的情绪更具挑战性. 在从单个文本转向对话时,姿态检测还需要了解对话的背景(Niu等人,2024年)。 例如,答复可能通过同意或不同意先前的言论来表达其立场,从而难以单凭答复确定立场。

blocks.en: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have provided new ways to address stance detection through their language understanding and contextual modeling abilities ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Weinzierl and Harabagiu, 2024 ) . Unlike conventional approaches that rely on task-specific labeled data, general-purpose LLMs can perform stance detection directly through task instructions, reducing the need for task-specific training ( Weinzierl and Harabagiu, 2024 ; Nguyen and Kim, 2025 ) . However, stance detection typically has a fixed set of labels, such as favor, against, and neutral ( Mohammad et al., 2016 ) . The model only needs to select the appropriate label rather than generate open-ended text. This raises an interesting question: can models designed specifically for structured decision-making achieve performance comparable to general-purpose LLMs on stance detection?
blocks.zh: 近年来,大型语言模型(LLMs)提供了通过语言理解和上下文建模能力解决站姿检测问题的新方法(Zhang等,2024;Weinzierl和Harabagiu,2024. 与依赖特定任务标注数据的常规方法不同,通用LLMS可以通过任务指示直接进行姿态检测,减少特定任务培训的需求(Weinzierl和Harabagiu,2024;Nguyen和Kim,2025. 然而,姿势检测通常有一套固定的标签,如对等标签和中性标签(Mohammad等,2016年)。 模型只需要选择适当的标签,而不是产生可自由参加的文本. 这提出了一个有趣的问题:专门为结构化决策设计的模型能否取得与定位检测方面的通用有限责任措施相类似的绩效?

blocks.en: Recently, Jev, a specialized decision model developed by TypeSafe AI, has offered a new way to explore this question ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . Jev is designed to make structured decisions, and its Choice interface selects an answer directly from a predefined set of options. Recent studies have explored its use in scientific, legal, clinical, and rubric-based decision tasks ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) , with some reporting advantages in efficiency ( Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) . Although this decision format fits the output requirements of stance detection, it remains unclear whether Jev can accurately identify an author’s stance toward a given target, especially in conversations where support or opposition may depend on earlier utterances. Therefore, evaluating Jev across different stance detection settings and comparing it with general-purpose LLMs can help reveal its performance and limitations.
blocks.zh: 最近,由TypeSafe AI开发的专门决定模型Jev提出了探讨这个问题的新方式(TypeSafe AI,2026). Jev旨在做出结构化决定,其Choice接口直接从预定义的一组选项中选择一个答案. 最近的研究探索了它在科学,法律,临床,和基于主题的决策任务中的应用(邓等,2026;张等,2026;黄等,2026;拉奥和Callison-Burch,2026),在效率方面有一些报告优势(Rao和Callison-Burch,2026). 虽然这种决定格式符合定位检测的产出要求,但Jev能否准确识别作者对特定目标的立场仍然不清楚,特别是在对话中,在对话中,支持或反对可能取决于先前的言论。 因此,通过不同姿态检测设置来评价Jev并将其与通用LLMS进行比较,有助于揭示其性能和局限性.

blocks.en: In this work, we conduct an empirical evaluation of Jev on both individual-text and conversational stance detection. Specifically, we use VAST ( Allaway and McKeown, 2020 ) , an English stance detection dataset, and ZS-CSD ( Ding et al., 2025 ) , a Chinese zero-shot conversational stance detection dataset, to evaluate Jev in two different settings. We compare Jev with four general-purpose LLMs: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash, GPT-5.6, and Claude Sonnet 5. We also include Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B fine-tuned with LoRA as supervised reference models. Through these experiments, we examine whether Jev can achieve competitive stance detection performance without task-specific training, and analyze its performance differences and error patterns across the two settings.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们对Jev进行关于个别文字和对话姿态探测的经验评估。 具体地说,我们使用VAST(Allaway and McKeown, 2020年),一个英语姿势检测数据集,以及ZS-CSD(Ding等,2025年),一个中国零发对话姿势检测数据集,在两种不同的场合评价Jev. 我们比较了Jev与四个通用的LLMs:DeepSeek V4.1 Flash,Qune3.8-Flash,GPT-5.6,和克洛德·索内 5. 我们还将Qune2.5-3B和Qune2.5-7B与LORA进行了微调,作为监督的参考模型. 通过这些实验,我们研究Jev能否在没有任务特定训练的情况下实现竞争姿势检测性能,并分析其表现差异和两种场合的错误模式.

blocks.en: Our results show that Jev performs differently across the two stance detection settings. On VAST, Jev achieves performance comparable to GPT-5.6 and outperforms the other general-purpose LLMs in our comparison, showing its potential for stance detection on individual texts. However, on ZS-CSD, Jev falls well behind GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5. Further analysis shows that Jev performs relatively well at distinguishing neutral from non-neutral stances but makes more errors when deciding whether a stance is in favor of or against the target. In addition, the performance gap between Jev and the stronger LLMs does not increase noticeably with conversation length. These findings suggest that Jev’s limitations in conversational stance detection may be related to its difficulty in understanding reply relationships and stance direction, rather than conversation length alone. Overall, our study shows that Jev can achieve competitive results in some stance detection settings but still faces challenges when stance judgments depend on conversational context. These findings provide initial evidence of its strengths and limitations in stance detection.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,Jev在两种姿势检测设置上的表现不同. 在VAST上,Jev取得了与GPT-5.6相仿的性能,并在我们的比较中超越了其他通用的LLMs,显示了它在单个文本上定位检测的潜力. 然而,在ZS-CSD上,Jev远远落后于GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内 5. 进一步的分析表明,Jev在区分中立立场和非中立立场方面表现相对良好,但在决定立场是赞成还是反对目标时却犯了更多的错误. 此外,Jev和较强的LLMS之间的性能差距并没有随着对话长度而明显增加. 这些调查结果表明,Jev在对话姿态探测方面的局限性可能与其难以理解答复关系和立场方向有关,而不只是对话长度。 总之,我们的研究表明,Jev在某些姿态检测环境中可以取得竞争结果,但在姿态判断取决于对话背景时仍然面临挑战。 这些调查结果提供了初步证据,说明其在定位探测方面的长处和局限性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Stance detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 Stance检测

blocks.en: Early work focuses on in-target stance detection, where training and evaluation use the same targets ( Mohammad et al., 2016 ) . These methods model the relationship between the target and the author’s text. For example, Du et al. (2017) use target-specific attention to identify relevant parts of the text instead of relying on a target-independent representation.
blocks.zh: 早期工作侧重于在目标内发现姿势,在那里,培训和评价使用相同的目标(Mohammad等,2016年)。 这些方法模拟了目标与作者文本之间的关系. 例如,Du等人(2017年)利用特定目标关注来确定文本的相关部分,而不是依赖目标独立的代表.

blocks.en: Cross-target research reduces the need for labeled data for each target by transferring knowledge between related targets. Xu et al. (2018) propose CrossNet, using self-attention to extract shared domain features. Zero-shot research evaluates generalization to unseen targets. Allaway and McKeown (2020) introduce VAST and use generalized topic representations to capture similarities between topics. Liang et al. (2022) propose JointCL, combining stance contrastive learning with target-aware prototypical graph contrastive learning to transfer stance features to unseen targets.
blocks.zh: 跨目标研究通过在相关目标之间转让知识,减少了对每个目标标注数据的需求. 徐等(2018年)提出"CrossNet",用自意取出共享域名. 零镜头研究评价被概括到看不见的目标. Allaway和McKeown(2020年)引入了VAST,并使用通用专题表述来捕捉各专题之间的相似性. 梁等(2022年)提出"联合CL",将站姿对比学习与目标认知的原生图对比学习相结合,将站姿特征转移到隐形目标.

blocks.en: Recent work also uses LLMs to supply knowledge for stance prediction. Zhang et al. (2024) extract text–target relationships with an LLM and inject this information into BART. This differs from our direct comparison of Jev with general-purpose LLMs, with fine-tuned models as supervised references.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还利用LLMs提供用于姿态预测的知识. Zhang等人(2024年)提取出文本-目标关系与LLM,并将此信息注入BART. 这不同于我们直接比较Jev与通用有限责任公司,以微调模型作为监督参考。

blocks.en: 2.2 Conversational stance detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 对话姿态探测

blocks.en: CSD studies stance expressed through interactions between speakers. Early work such as SRQ distinguishes replies from quoted tweets and evaluates stance prediction for these response types ( Villa-Cox et al., 2020 ) . Multi-turn conversations require modeling dependencies beyond the immediate reply. Niu et al. (2024) introduce MT-CSD and GLAN, which combines global attention with local convolutional and graph-based branches to capture long- and short-range dependencies. These methods use dialogue structure to recover information that may be absent from the current utterance.
blocks.zh: 可持续发展委员会通过发言者之间的互动表达的研究立场。 早期的工作如SRQ区分了来自被引用的微博的答复,并评价了这些响应类型的立场预测(Villa-Cox等,2020年). 多回合对话需要在即时答复之外建立依赖模式。 Niu等人(2024年)引入了MT-CSD和GLAN,它们将全球关注与本地的分会和以图为基础的分会结合起来,捕捉长程和短程的依赖. 这些方法使用对话结构来获取当前言论中可能缺失的信息.

blocks.en: Target generalization is also important in conversations, where new discussion topics may lack labeled examples. Ding et al. (2025) introduce ZS-CSD, a Chinese benchmark with unseen test targets covering noun phrases and claims. Their SITPCL model combines a speaker interaction network with target-aware prototypical contrastive learning. The interaction network models dependencies within and between speakers, while contrastive learning supports generalization across targets. This line of work brings together two requirements: interpreting the current speaker’s stance in context and transferring that interpretation to unfamiliar targets. Our evaluation includes both through the full ZS-CSD test set.
blocks.zh: 目标概括在对话中也很重要,在这些对话中,新的讨论议题可能缺乏标有标签的例子。 丁来等. (2025年)引入了ZS-CSD,是中国的一项基准,其隐形测试目标涵盖名词短语和主张. 他们的SITPCL模型结合了一个扬声器交互网络与目标认知的原始对比性学习. 演讲者内部和之间的互动网络模型依赖性,而对比性学习则支持跨目标的通俗化. 这项工作包括两项要求:解释目前发言者的立场,把这种解释转移到不熟悉的目标。 我们的评价包括通过完整的ZS-CSD测试集。

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluations of Jev
blocks.zh: 2.3 对Jev的评价

blocks.en: Recent studies evaluate Jev on scientific ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , legal ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , clinical ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and rubric-based ( Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) judgments. These evaluations concern decisions made under domain-specific criteria. We use stance detection to examine decisions conditioned on a target and, for conversational records, on the history needed to interpret the current utterance.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究 Jev on science (Deng等, 2026), legal (张等, 2026), 临床 (Huang等,2026年),并按"鲁克"(Rao and Callison-Burch,2026年)判决. 这些评价涉及根据特定领域标准作出的决定。 我们利用姿势检测来检查以目标为条件的决定,对于对话记录来说,审查解释当前言论所需的历史。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We use Jev’s Choice interface to solve the tasks in Section 3.1 . Each request combines one record’s structured input, a task instruction, and a written criterion for each stance label.
blocks.zh: 我们用Jev的选择界面来解决第3.1节中的任务。 每个请求将一个记录的结构化输入、任务指示和每个姿态标签的书面标准结合起来。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和评价衡量标准

blocks.en: VAST ( Allaway and McKeown, 2020 ) contains English text–target pairs for stance detection. We evaluate all 3,006 official test records, including the seen-target (few-shot) and unseen-target (zero-shot) subsets, and retain repeated records.
blocks.zh: VAST (Allaway and McKeown, 2020) 包含英语文本-目标对子用于姿态检测. 我们评价所有3 006个正式测试记录,包括已见目标(few-shot)和未见目标(0-shot)子集,并保留重复记录。

blocks.en: ZS-CSD ( Ding et al., 2025 ) evaluates Chinese conversational stance toward unseen targets. We use all 2,584 official test records, covering noun-phrase and claim targets. Exact target strings are disjoint across training, development, and test splits. For context, SITPCL, the best model in the original paper, reaches 43.81% macro-F1 on this test set.
blocks.zh: ZS-CSD(Ding等,2025年)评价 中国对隐形目标采取对话立场. 我们使用所有2 584个正式测试记录,涵盖名词和索赔目标。 精确的目标字符串在训练、开发和测试分裂之间是脱节的。 对于上下文,SITPCL作为原始论文中最好的模型,在这个测试集上达到了43.81%的宏-F1.

blocks.en: 4.2 Models and inputs
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式和投入

blocks.en: We call a system prompted when it is used without task-specific fine-tuning or in-context demonstrations. All five prompted systems receive the target and the focus text, with speaker-tagged history for ZS-CSD. Jev follows the Choice procedure in Section 3 , while the LLMs receive the label definitions in a shorter prose instruction (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 我们称之为在没有针对具体任务的微调或内文演示的情况下使用所激发的系统。 所有五个被催促的系统都收到目标和焦点文本,ZS-CSD的语音标记历史。 Jev遵循了第3节中的"选择程序",而LLMs则在更短的取词指令(Appendix A.

blocks.en: Jev. We request jev-latest, returned as jev-1.13.0, and classify one record per Choice request.
blocks.zh: Jev,我们要求Jev -latest, 返回为Jev-1.13.0, 按选择请求分类一个记录。

blocks.en: Flash models. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) is called through the Responses API with a schema-constrained stance field, and Qwen3.8-Flash ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) through an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API with JSON output. Both use temperature zero and a 32-token output limit, with thinking disabled.
blocks.zh: 闪光模型. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash(DeepSeek,2026年)通过反应API调用,其站姿场有计划限制;而Qune3.8-Flash(Alibaba Cloud,2026年)则通过一个OpenAI相容的ChatProfessions API调用JSON输出. 两者都使用温度0和32个托肯输出限制,思维被禁用.

blocks.en: GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5. GPT-5.6 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) runs through Codex CLI with no tools and reasoning effort set to none. Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) is also evaluated with thinking disabled. Unlike the other three systems, which classify one record per request, GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 receive up to 100 and 25 records per request, respectively, and are instructed to classify each record independently.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内 5. GPT-5.6(OpenAI,2026年)通过Codex CLI运行,没有任何工具和推理努力。 Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic, 2026) 也被评为思维残疾. 与其他三个系统不同的是,GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 5)分别收到最多100和25个记录,并被指示将每个记录单独分类.

blocks.en: SFT references. As supervised fine-tuning (SFT) references, we train Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and 7B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) on each training split, with learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , five epochs, and seed 42. Only their single-run scores are available, so the paired and subgroup analyses cover the five prompted systems.
blocks.zh: SFT参考文献. 作为监督的微调参考,我们在每次培训中与LORA(Hu等,2021年)一起对Quen2.5-3B-Instruct和7B-Instruct(Quen Team,2024年)进行分期培训,学习率5×10-5 5\times 10×5),5个历程,和种子42. 只有他们的单跑分数可用,所以对子和分子分析覆盖了五个被激发的系统.

blocks.zh: 4.3 实验设置

blocks.en: The single-record runs of Jev, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and Qwen3.8-Flash were collected on September 21–24, 2026, with 16 concurrent requests and up to three retries with backoff. GPT-5.6 processes each dataset in sequential batches, and Claude Sonnet 5 resumes from checkpoints, splitting failed batches until all records are recovered. Each record is scored once on its final outcome. Jev, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-5.6, and Claude Sonnet 5 return valid final predictions throughout both tests. Qwen3.8-Flash has one VAST request rejected by content screening; its effect on the score is small, but it remains in the full-test denominator. Appendix B summarizes the reasoning settings.
blocks.zh: Jev,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash,和Qune3.8-Flash的单唱片跑道于2026年9月21–24日被收录,同时有16个请求,最多有3个回回放. GPT-5.6按相继批次处理每个数据集,克洛德·索内特5从检查站恢复,分出故障批次直至所有记录被找回. 每张唱片的最终结果都得分一次。 Jev, 深层搜索 V4.1 Flash,GPT-5.6,和克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet)5在两次测试中都返回了有效的最终预测. Qune3.8-Flash有一个被内容筛选所拒绝的VAST请求;其对分数的影响很小,但仍保留在全测试分母中. 附 录 B总结了推理设置.

blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.zh: 图1:Jev与每个LLM(Jev减去LLM,以百分点计)之间的宏-F1差异,配对目标-波斯特拉95%间隔.

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the overall performance and resource usage of the evaluated models on VAST and ZS-CSD. Figure 1 further shows the paired macro-F1 differences between Jev and the four general-purpose LLMs. We summarize the main findings as follows.
blocks.zh: 表1列示了受评估的VAST和ZS-CSD模型的总体绩效和资源使用情况。 图1还显示了Jev与四个通用LLMs的配对宏-F1差异. 我们总结主要调查结果如下。

blocks.en: (1) Jev performs competitively on VAST but shows a substantial performance gap on ZS-CSD. On VAST, Jev achieves 77.92% macro-F1, only 0.16 percentage points below GPT-5.6 (78.08%) and outperforming the other three general-purpose LLMs. The paired confidence interval for the difference between Jev and GPT-5.6 includes zero, indicating that the observed difference is not statistically significant under our evaluation. However, this competitive performance does not extend to ZS-CSD. Jev achieves 58.43% macro-F1, falling 15.19 and 13.99 points behind GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5, respectively. Both differences are supported by the paired confidence intervals. These results suggest that Jev can handle stance classification in individual English texts effectively, but remains less competitive in the more challenging Chinese conversational setting.
blocks.zh: (1) Jev在VAST上的竞争表现,但在ZS-CSD上表现出很大的表现差距. 在VAST上,Jev取得了77.92%的宏-F1,比GPT-5.6(78.08%)低0.16个百分点,并优于其他三个通用LLM. Jev和GPT-5.6之间差异的对接置信间隔为零,表明在我们的评价中所观察到的差异在统计学上并不重要. 然而,这种竞争表现并没有延伸到ZS-CSD. Jev实现58.43%的宏-F1,分别比GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内特5落后15.19和13.99分. 两种差异都得到对接的置信间隔的支持. 这些结果表明,Jev能够有效地处理单个英文文本中的立场分类,但在更具挑战性的中文对话环境中,其竞争力仍然较低.

blocks.en: (2) Jev offers a favorable performance–cost trade-off, particularly on VAST. Jev outperforms both DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash in macro-F1 on the two datasets, although its advantage over DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on ZS-CSD is not statistically established. More importantly, Jev achieves these results at a relatively low inference cost. On VAST, its recorded API cost is only $0.0741, compared with $3.9010 for GPT-5.6, despite their nearly identical macro-F1 scores. Similar cost differences are observed on ZS-CSD, although Jev performs substantially worse than the stronger LLMs. These findings indicate that Jev can be a cost-effective option for stance detection when its accuracy meets task requirements, especially for individual-text classification.
blocks.zh: (2) Jev提供了一种有利的业绩-成本取舍,特别是在VAST方面。 Jev在两个数据集上的"DeepSeek V4.1 Flash"和"Quen3.8-Flash"在宏-F1中都优于双子,虽然其在"ZS-CSD"上相对于"DeepSeek V4.1 Flash"的优势并没有在统计学上建立. 更重要的是,Jev以相对较低的推论成本实现了这些结果. 在VAST上,其记录的API成本仅为0.0741美元,而GPT-5.6则只有3.9010美元,尽管其宏-F1分数几乎相同. ZS-CSD也有类似的成本差异,虽然Jev的性能比较强的LLMS要差得多. 这些调查结果表明,Jev在准确性符合任务要求时,特别是符合个别文字分类要求时,可以成为检测姿态的成本效益高的选择.

blocks.en: (3) Jev achieves comparable performance to task-specific fine-tuned models without additional training. On VAST, Jev achieves 77.92% macro-F1, outperforming the LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-3B (74.52%) but falling below Qwen2.5-7B (79.91%). A similar pattern appears on ZS-CSD, where Jev achieves 58.43%, compared with 56.08% and 60.85% for the two fine-tuned models. Although Jev does not outperform the larger fine-tuned model, it achieves competitive results without requiring task-specific training. This provides an additional reference point for evaluating the potential of specialized decision models on stance detection tasks.
blocks.zh: (3)Jev实现与任务特定微调模型的可比较性能,无需额外培训. 在VAST上,Jev实现了77.92%的宏-F1,优于LORA调制的Quen2.5-3B(74.52%),但低于Quen2.5-7B(79.91%). ZS-CSD也出现了类似的模式,Jev取得了58.43%的成绩,而两个微调模型的成绩分别为56.08%和60.85%. 虽然Jev的表现没有超过更大的微调模式,但它在不需要具体任务培训的情况下取得了竞争结果. 这为评估关于姿态检测任务的专门决策模式的潜力提供了又一参考点。

blocks.en: 5.2 Class-level Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 职等业绩

blocks.en: On VAST, Jev achieves performance comparable to GPT-5.6 across all three stance categories (Table 2 ). GPT-5.6 performs slightly better on favor (73.95% vs. 72.71%) and against (78.25% vs. 77.13%), while Jev achieves the highest F1 on neutral (83.92%). These results indicate that Jev maintains competitive performance across different stance categories on individual English texts, consistent with the overall results.
blocks.zh: 在VAST上,Jev在所有三个姿态类别中都取得了与GPT-5.6相仿的性能(表2. GPT-5.6在优惠方面表现略好(73.95%对72.71%),相对(78.25%对77.13%),而Jev在中性方面达到最高的F1(83.92%)。 这些结果表明,Jev在英文文本上保持不同类别不同的竞争业绩,与总体结果一致。

blocks.en: On ZS-CSD, however, the performance differences are more pronounced. GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 substantially outperform Jev on favor and against, while their neutral F1 scores remain relatively close. For example, GPT-5.6 exceeds Jev by more than 22 percentage points on both favor and against, but achieves a similar F1 on neutral (58.67% vs. 59.04%). The confusion analysis further shows that Jev makes 373 favor–against errors, compared with only 35 for GPT-5.6 and 101 for Claude Sonnet 5 (Table 5 ). These findings suggest that Jev’s main difficulty on ZS-CSD lies in distinguishing support from opposition, rather than in the neutral category. This may reflect limitations in interpreting stance direction when opinions are expressed through interactions between speakers.
blocks.zh: 然而,在ZS-CSD方面,表现差异更为明显. GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 5)在优胜优胜和优胜优胜上大幅胜过Jev,而他们的中性F1分数仍然相对接近. 例如,GPT-5.6 超过 Jev在优胜和优胜中均以超过22个百分点的成绩,但在中性上却实现了相近的F1(58.67%对59.04%). 混乱分析进一步表明,Jev对错误作出了373项优惠,而GPT-5.6只有35项,Claude Sonnet 5只有101项(表5)。 这些调查结果表明,Jev在ZS-CSD问题上的主要困难在于区别支持和反对,而不是中立的类别. 这可能反映出在通过发言者之间的互动发表意见时,在解释立场方向方面的局限性。

blocks.en: 5.3 Performance across Target Types
blocks.zh: 5.3 各类目标的业绩

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the macro-F1 scores on the two target types in ZS-CSD. All five models perform better on noun-phrase targets than on claim targets, suggesting that stance detection becomes more challenging when targets are expressed as complete propositions. For Jev, macro-F1 decreases from 63.49% on noun phrases to 55.26% on claims. A similar trend is observed for the other models. This may be because claim targets often contain more complex semantic information, such as negation or qualifying conditions, which requires more precise interpretation of the target.
blocks.zh: 表3报告ZS-CSD两种目标类型的宏-F1分数。 所有五个模型在名词标的上的表现都好于在索赔标的上的表现,这表明当目标被表述为完整命题时,姿态检测就变得更具挑战性. 对于Jev,宏F1从名词短语的63.49%下降到债权的55.26%. 其他模型也有类似趋势。 这可能是因为索赔目标往往包含更复杂的语义信息,例如否定或限定条件,这需要对目标作出更准确的解释.

blocks.en: Jev outperforms the two Flash models on both target types but remains substantially behind GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5. In particular, the gap between Jev and GPT-5.6 is 14.53 percentage points on noun phrases and 15.46 points on claims. These results indicate that Jev’s performance limitations on ZS-CSD are consistent across different target types, rather than being restricted to a particular type of target.
blocks.zh: Jev在两种目标类型上的表现都超过了两种Flash模型,但仍大大落后于GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内5. 特别是Jev和GPT-5.6之间的差距为名词短语的14.53个百分点和债权的15.46个百分点. 这些结果表明,Jev对ZS-CSD的性能限制在不同的目标类型之间是一致的,而不是局限于特定类型的目标.

blocks.en: Table 4: Macro-F1 scores (%) across different conversation lengths on ZS-CSD. Bold indicates the best result for each group.
blocks.zh: 表4:ZS-CSD上不同对话长度的宏-F1分数(%). 粗体表示每个组的最佳结果.

blocks.en: 5.4 Performance across Conversation Lengths
blocks.zh: 5.4 跨对话时间的表现

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the macro-F1 scores across different conversation lengths on ZS-CSD. Jev achieves the highest score on single-turn inputs, although this group contains only 45 samples. For conversations with two or more turns, GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 consistently outperform Jev. Notably, the performance gap does not increase steadily with conversation length. For example, the gap between Jev and GPT-5.6 decreases from 22.69 percentage points for two-turn conversations to 14.20 points for conversations with six or more turns. These results suggest that Jev’s limitations in conversational stance detection cannot be explained by conversation length alone. Instead, its difficulty may also involve interpreting stance relationships between speakers, even in relatively short conversations.
blocks.zh: 表4在ZS-CSD上报告不同对话长度的宏-F1分数。 Jev在单回合输入上获得最高分数,虽然这个组只包含45个样本. 对于两个或两个以上回合的对话,GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 5)的成绩一直高于Jev. 值得注意的是,性能差距没有随着对话长度而稳步增加. 例如,Jev和GPT-5.6之间的差距从双回合对话的22.69个百分点下降到以6个或更多回合对话的14.20个百分点. 这些结果表明,Jev在对话姿态探测方面的局限性不能仅用对话时间来解释。 相反,其困难还可能涉及解释发言者之间的立场关系,即使在较短的交谈中也是如此。

blocks.en: Appendix A Prompts and Input Construction
blocks.zh: 附录A 提示和输入构建

blocks.en: Inputs retain their original language. Reference labels and sample-selection metadata are not included in model inputs. The instructions and label definitions are given below.
blocks.zh: 投入保留了原文。 参考标签和样本选择元数据不列入模型输入. 说明和标签定义如下:

blocks.en: Determine the stance expressed by the focus text toward the target. Use conversation context only to resolve the focus text. Choose exactly one label according to the criteria. The criteria of its three options are: • favor : The focus text supports, approves of, argues for, or expresses a positive attitude toward the target. • against : The focus text opposes, rejects, criticizes, argues against, or expresses a negative attitude toward the target. • neutral : The focus text has no discernible stance toward the target, is unrelated, merely reports information, or is too ambiguous to label as favor or against.
blocks.zh: 确定重点案文对目标表达的立场。 仅使用对话上下文解决焦点文本。 根据标准选择一个标签 。 其三种选择的标准是: 重点案文支持、核准、主张或表示对目标的积极态度。 • 反对: 重点案文反对、拒绝、批评、反对或表达对目标的消极态度。 • 中立: 重点案文对目标没有明显的立场,无关紧要,只是报告信息,或者过于含糊不清,不能标榜为偏袒或反对。

blocks.en: favor : The focus text supports, approves of, argues for, or expresses a positive attitude toward the target.
blocks.zh: 赞成 : 重点案文支持、核准、主张或表示对目标的积极态度。

blocks.en: against : The focus text opposes, rejects, criticizes, argues against, or expresses a negative attitude toward the target.
blocks.zh: 反对: 重点案文反对、拒绝、批评、反对或表达对目标的消极态度。

blocks.en: neutral : The focus text has no discernible stance toward the target, is unrelated, merely reports information, or is too ambiguous to label as favor or against.
blocks.zh: 中性 : 重点案文对目标没有明显的立场,无关紧要,只是报告信息,或者过于含糊不清,不能标榜为偏袒或反对。

blocks.en: The DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash requests begin with this text: You are a stance classifier. Determine the stance expressed by the focus text toward the target. Use earlier conversation only to interpret the focus text. Favor means support or approval; against means opposition, rejection, or criticism; neutral means no discernible stance, unrelated, merely informational, or too ambiguous. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash constrains the response with a stance-enum schema. Qwen3.8-Flash requests a single-key JSON object, and its label is validated in the client.
blocks.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 Quen3.8-Flash 请求开始于此文本: 你是一个姿态分类。 确定重点案文对目标表达的立场。 使用更早的对话只用于解释焦点文本. 偏爱是指支持或认可;反对是指反对、拒绝或批评;中立是指没有明显的立场、无关、仅仅是信息或过于含糊。 深层搜索 V4.1 Flash用姿态-enum schema来约束响应. Qune3.8-Flash请求单键JSON对象,其标签在客户端中被验证.

blocks.en: GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 share the same stance criteria, with explicit instructions to classify each record independently, use earlier turns only to interpret its focus text, avoid tools, and return one prediction per input ID in the same order as JSON. Each batch contains test IDs and inputs, without reference labels.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6和克洛德·索内特5有着相同的姿态标准,有明确的指令将每个记录独立分类,使用更早的转弯只用于解释其焦点文本,避免工具,并按JSON的相同顺序返回每个输入ID一个预测. 每批装有测试ID和输入,没有参考标签.

blocks.en: Section 3.2 specifies the structured input construction. We add no translation, retrieval, manual text editing, or few-shot examples.
